question: If the ratio of radius of the bases of two cylinders is 4 : 5 and the ratio of their heights is 5 : 2, then the ratio of their volumes is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume ratio = (Ratio of radii)² × (Ratio of heights)

V₁ : V₂ = (4 / 5)² × (5 / 2)

V₁ : V₂ = (16 / 25) × (5 / 2) = 8 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radius of the bases, r₁ : r₂ = 4 : 5

Ratio of their heights, h₁ : h₂ = 5 : 2

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder (V) = πr²h

 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 Cylinder 1
 
 
 
• 
 h₁=5
 
 
 
 
• 
 r₁=4

 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 Cylinder 2

 
 
• 
 h₂=2
 
 
 
 
• 
 r₂=5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of volumes = V₁ : V₂

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = (π × r₁² × h₁) : (π × r₂² × h₂)

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = (r₁ / r₂)² × (h₁ / h₂)

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = (4 / 5)² × (5 / 2)

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = (16 / 25) × (5 / 2)

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = 8 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume of a right circular cylinder is calculated by multiplying the area of its base by its height using the formula: V = πr²h.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved walls or lateral surface of a cylinder is given by the formula: CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total surface area includes both the curved surface and the two circular flat bases, calculated as: TSA = 2πr(h + r).
